limitations: The Codex technical assessor has access to the preparation and remediation context and is not independent.
The current runtime cannot verifiably disable Memory, automatic Git checks, automatic Repository reads, or AGENTS/HANDOFF preloads.
Deterministic validation proves only the declared artifact, hash, binding, and state contracts; it does not prove independent reviewer identity or clean-room isolation.
Technical recommendations do not close Findings and cannot authorize downstream work.
Final Finding decisions and rationale must be supplied separately by the Human adjudicator.
